1609-This six-code contract is new and deliberately **different** from `eval gate`'s four codes below — see that command's own doc
for why the two are not unified. An invalid suite file exits **2** either way — `eval validate` still exits 1 for the same contra
ct failure, because it is a verdict on the file and this command is not.
1611-| Flag | Required | Description |
1613-| `--suite <id-or-name>` | Yes, unless `--file` | Eval suite name or ID |
1614-| `--file <path>` | Yes, unless `--suite` | Versioned suite file to upload and run (`.yaml` or `.json`, or `-` for stdin) |
1615-| `--project <id-or-name>` | No | Project name or ID (defaults to the most recently updated project) |
1616-| `--server <id-or-name...>` | No | Override the suite's saved server selection (HTTP servers only) |
1617-| `--environment <id-or-name...>` | No | Attached project environment(s) to run. Several values start one **paid run each**.
1618-| `--client <id-or-name...>` | No | Attached client(s) to run, so the run is stamped with that client's config. Several value
s start one **paid run each**. |
1619-| `--host <id-or-name...>` | No | **Deprecated** alias for `--client`. Passing both is an error. Not the host-compat catalog
id `mcpjam compat --host` / `mcpjam tools --host` take — see [Two different `--host` flags](#two-different---host-flags). |
1620-| `--all-targets` | No | Run **every** attached environment (or, if none, every attached host) — one **paid run per target**
1621-| `--iterations <n>` | No | Run each case this many times (1-10), for this run only |
1622-| `--repetitions <n>` | No | **Legacy** spelling of `--iterations`. Passing both is an error. |
1623-| `--case <id-or-title...>` | No | Run only these cases instead of the whole suite |
1624-| `--exclude-skills` | No | Run the "without skills" A/B arm: nothing is pinned, and the run is labelled as excluded |
1625-| `--refresh-snapshot` | No | **Persists a new host-config snapshot on the suite** (see below). Single-target runs only. |
1626-| `--notes <text>` | No | Free-text note stored on the run |
1627-| `--min-pass-rate <n>` | No | Pass threshold for this run (0-100), overriding the suite's own |
1628-| `--match-options <json>` | No | Tool-call match options for this run, e.g. `'{"toolCallOrder":"exact"}'` |
1629-| `--idempotency-key <key>` | No | Retry key for a lost launch response. For `--file`, a fresh key is minted and printed on e
very invocation when this flag is omitted; supply the printed key to replay the same run instead of starting a new one |
1630-| `--wait` | No | Wait for every launched run to reach a terminal status |
1680:under `cloud eval`.
1682-| Command | `--host` names |
1684-| `mcpjam tools` / `resources` / `prompts` / `probe` / `compat` | A **host-compat catalog id** — which AI host to emulate. `c
laude`, `chatgpt`, `cursor`, `copilot`, `codex`, `goose`, and the rest of the catalog. |
1685:| `mcpjam cloud eval run` / `cases run` / `update` / `create` | A **client saved in your project** (`mcpjam cloud clients lis
1687-The catalog sense keeps `--host`: it genuinely means "which AI host am I
1688:emulating". Under `cloud eval`, **`--client` is canonical** and `--host` is a
1689:deprecated alias for it — so `mcpjam cloud eval run --host claude` looks for a
1690-saved client named `claude` and fails if you do not have one. When the value
1691-you pass is a catalog id, the error says so and points at `--client`.
1693-#### Which target runs
1695-**Fan-out is explicit and never inferred.** Choosing for you would be choosing
1696-how much to spend, so:
1698-* **nothing attached** → the suite's saved server selection runs (unchanged);
1699-* **exactly one** attached environment or client → that one runs
1700- automatically, and the run is stamped with its configuration;
1701-* **several attached**
